pack.title: Starter: general nonprofit
pack.description: For a nonprofit organization: programs and the people they serve, fundraising and donors, volunteers, and restricted funding. No research or clinical map.

tiers.label: 1 · Mission critical
tiers.description: The people the organization serves go without help

tiers.label: 2 · Business critical
tiers.description: Important work stops within a day without it

tiers.label: 3 · Business operational
tiers.description: Its loss would be felt within days and worked around

tiers.label: 4 · Administrative
tiers.description: Could be done without for weeks with little effect

tiers.label: 5 · Minimal
tiers.description: Could be switched off with almost no effect

data_classes.label: Public
data_classes.description: May be shared with anyone: published results, public web content.

data_classes.label: Internal
data_classes.description: Meant for the organization's own work: plans, procedures, most email.

data_classes.label: Personal information
data_classes.description: About identifiable staff, students, donors, or the public.

data_classes.label: Protected health information
data_classes.description: Health information about identifiable patients, held under health privacy law.

data_classes.label: Payment card data
data_classes.description: Card numbers and related data, held under the card industry's rules.

data_classes.label: Donor information
data_classes.description: About donors and prospects: giving history, contact, and wealth notes.

data_classes.label: Client records
data_classes.description: About the people the organization serves, often vulnerable: cases, needs, and services.

children.name: Data platform and integration

fields.label: Accessibility
fields.help: How well people with disabilities can use it, as last checked.

definition.text: An application is software, or a service built from software, that people name, use for a purpose, and could decide to keep, change, or retire as one thing.
not_examples: A server or a database on its own: record it as a component of what it serves
A report or a module of a larger system: a component of that system
A spreadsheet one person keeps for themselves
A programming language or a platform: a technology
